en.summary: This commit fixes outbound cache memory-request formatting so read transactions use a full-line byte-enable instead of reusing a partial write mask.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a cache byte-enable bug fix.
The patch changes the DUT cache-bank logic that formats lower-memory requests.
Using the wrong byte-enable on reads is a direct correctness error in the cache-to-memory interface.
evidence: In writeback mode, mreq_queue_byteen now uses dirty_byteen_st1 only for fill/flush writeback traffic and uses all ones for the other path.
In non-writeback mode, mreq_queue_byteen now uses write_byteen_st1 only for writes and all ones for reads.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache miss read or line fill request sent to the next memory level should usually request the full cache line. Partial byte-enable masks are only valid for stores or dirty-byte writebacks. If the request formatter reuses a store mask on a read transaction, the lower memory can observe a partial-line request and the cache may refill a line with missing or corrupted bytes.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A cache issues a read/fill transaction to lower memory, especially after a previous write path has produced a non-all-ones byte mask.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reuse the write or dirty-byte mask on read transactions instead of forcing a full-line byte-enable.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse write byte mask for reads
portability_notes: Map this to any cache or linefill unit that carries byte enables on the lower-memory request bus.
The bug is most visible when the preceding operation left a sparse store mask or dirty-byte mask in the request formatter.
Keep write traffic correct so the failure stays isolated to read/fill transactions.
concrete_injection_steps: In the lower-memory request formatter, leave writeback or store byte-mask selection unchanged.
For read or fill requests, stop overriding the byte-enable to all ones and instead forward the existing partial mask.
Do not change the returned line data path; the bug should come from malformed read requests, not from response decoding.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix makes mreq_queue_byteen equal to all ones on read/fill traffic while preserving partial masks only for writes or dirty-byte writebacks.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the old assignments where mreq_queue_byteen always follows dirty_byteen_st1 in writeback mode or write_byteen_st1 in non-writeback mode, even for reads.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Cache read or fill requests can become partial-line transactions, causing incomplete refills or corrupted load data.
evidence_for_injection: The patch is entirely localized to byte-enable selection in the memory-request queue formatter.
Both writeback and non-writeback paths explicitly changed from mask reuse to full-line enables on reads.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了缓存向下一级内存发请求时的格式化逻辑，使读事务使用整行 byte-enable，而不是复用部分写掩码。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 cache byte-enable bug。
补丁修改了 DUT 中 cache bank 负责格式化下游内存请求的逻辑。
在读事务上使用错误 byte-enable 会直接破坏 cache 到 memory 接口的正确性。
evidence: 在 writeback 模式下，mreq_queue_byteen 现在只对 fill/flush 的写回流量使用 dirty_byteen_st1，其他路径改为全 1。
在非 writeback 模式下，mreq_queue_byteen 现在只对写请求使用 write_byteen_st1，对读请求改为全 1。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 缓存 miss 读或 line fill 发往下一级内存时，通常应该请求整条 cache line。部分 byte-enable 只适用于 store 或 dirty-byte writeback。如果请求格式化逻辑在读事务上复用了 store 掩码，那么下级内存就会看到一个部分行请求，缓存最终可能以缺字节或损坏的数据完成 refill。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 缓存向下级内存发出读或 fill 事务，且此前写路径产生过非全 1 的 byte mask。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在读事务上复用写或 dirty-byte 掩码，而不是强制使用整行全 1 byte-enable。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse write byte mask for reads
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在下级内存请求总线上携带 byte enable 的 cache 或 linefill 单元。
当上一个操作在请求格式化逻辑里留下稀疏 store mask 或 dirty-byte mask 时，这个故障最容易暴露。
保持写流量正确，这样错误就会集中在读/fill 事务上。
concrete_injection_steps: 在下级内存请求格式化逻辑中，保持写回或 store 的 byte-mask 选择不变。
对读或 fill 请求，取消“强制全 1”的覆盖，改为直接转发已有的部分掩码。
不要改动返回数据路径；故障应来自畸形的读请求，而不是响应解码。

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复让 mreq_queue_byteen 在读/fill 流量上始终为全 1，而部分掩码只保留给写或 dirty-byte writeback。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧赋值：让 mreq_queue_byteen 在 writeback 模式下始终跟随 dirty_byteen_st1、在非 writeback 模式下始终跟随 write_byteen_st1，即使是读请求也如此。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: cache 的读或 fill 请求会退化为部分行事务，导致 refill 不完整或 load 数据损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁完全局限在 memory-request queue formatter 中的 byte-enable 选择。
writeback 和非 writeback 两条路径都从“读时复用旧掩码”改成了“读时使用整行使能”。
